_comment: Every tuning number lives here. Distances are world units: the castaway is about 150 units tall, and image 06 is drawn at that scale.

view._comment: How much of the world fits across the short side of the screen. 750 units on a 360pt-wide phone makes the castaway about 72pt tall and the island about four screens wide.

world._fieldComment: The island's fields are sampled on a power-of-two grid so the GPU can filter them.

island._comment: The home island: about 20 castaway-heights across.

camp._comment: Camp sits on the west coast. The fire is the centre; every other position is an offset from it, measured off image 06.

resources._rockMixComment: Share of the rocks drawn from each size in image 10.

stats._comment: Starting values from the brief. The stats system (milestone 2) drains and refills them.

walk._comment: Stepping until walk-cycle art exists, in image-03 pixels (the castaway is about 310 tall there).

fishing._comment: How close to the waterline (world units) he must stand to fish from the beach.

ambience._windComment: Palms by wind strength. Calm days only lean gently; the frame-by-frame sway from image 04 is for wind. The weather system (milestone 2) changes the wind; until then it stays at startWind.
